fix: NY-only means NY-only. A Sunday-evening Asia trade on XFA breaks the rule even when it wins. A winning rule break is the most dangerous kind, because it teaches you that breaking the rule pays.
If you practice on paper, log the entry, stop and RR box in Notion. Without that, a correct read is never tested.
Notion housekeeping: today's Results and Long or Short are empty. Set Results to 'No Trades' (or log the paper trade) so the calendar shows the day.
Sunday's notes say 'it was 50 bucks i missed'. Measure the close in R, not dollars.
Your End of Day card for today isn't filed yet (due by midnight ET). File it, and say 'Rules Followed: No' for Sunday's Asia trade if you count it in this trading day.
